run_angle_difference_tests: run the test suite to validate angle_difference and interpolate_angles functions
test_angle_difference_basic: test angle_difference with basic positive values like 1 and 2 radians
test_angle_difference_pi: test angle_difference with 0 and pi radians to verify half-circle difference
test_angle_interpolation: test interpolate_angles to verify stepping toward target angle by a given step size
test_angle_wrapping: test angle_difference with negative and wrapping angles near 2*pi boundaries
